title: Two Diagonals at Once
setup: The rook on a7 has nothing guarding it and the king on g7 is out in the open — and one square sees them both.
hint: Attack the rook down its own file and it simply takes you. Look for the square where two separate diagonals leave in opposite directions.
explanation:
## The Idea

The old queen crawled one diagonal square at a time. The new one stands where two long lines cross.

{{Qd4+}} checks the king on g7 up one diagonal and hits the rook on a7 down the other. The rook cannot hit back: d4 is on neither its file nor its rank.

Whatever Black does about the check, {{Kg8}} or anything else, does nothing for the rook, and {{Qxa7}} collects it.

Chase the rook down the a-file instead and it takes your queen.
